errors.means: The tool name is not one Desk's server serves; the reply lists the served tools and, when one is close, a near match.
errors.fix: Call one of the listed tools, such as the near match named in the reply.

doors.when: Starting a fresh unit of work under a track, optionally focusing this session on it at once

errors.means: The slug is not 1 to 6 lowercase kebab-case words of at most 48 characters, or reads like a prompt or a credential.
errors.fix: Pick a short outcome name such as fix-login-timeout and call again.

errors.means: A live task with that track and slug already exists, so nothing was created.
errors.fix: Update the existing card with task_update, or choose another slug.

errors.means: A task with that track and slug sits in the track's archive.
errors.fix: Bring it back with task_update and unarchive: true, or choose another slug.

errors.means: Desk was still admitting or verifying this session's desk, so the call was refused before anything ran.
errors.fix: Call desk_status, then repeat the call once it reports ready.

doors.when: Recording progress, a status change, resources, a log entry or a rename on a card that already exists

errors.means: No task card exists at the given track and slug.
errors.fix: Check the track and slug with desk_search, then call again.

errors.means: The call named a field task_update does not take, so nothing was changed.
errors.fix: Remove the field; the message lists the accepted ones.

errors.means: Moving the task to an earlier status is a return, and the call gave no return_reason.
errors.fix: Repeat the call with return_reason set to one of the listed values.

errors.means: Moving a task to done needs evidence, and the call gave none.
errors.fix: Pass evidence with a kind and ref, such as a merged pull request URL.

errors.means: Desk was still admitting or verifying this session's desk, so the call was refused before anything ran.
errors.fix: Call desk_status, then repeat the call once it reports ready.

errors.means: No task folder exists at that track and slug, live or archived.
errors.fix: Check the track and slug with desk_search, then call again.

errors.means: The call passed both evidence and outcome cancelled.
errors.fix: Pass evidence for finished work or outcome cancelled for abandoned work, not both.

errors.means: The archive already holds a folder with that slug while the live one also exists.
errors.fix: Rename one of the two folders with task_update, then archive again.

errors.means: The card changed on disk during the archive after the folder had moved into _archive; outside edits were kept.
errors.fix: Read the reply's archive_phase and actual_path for where it is, then finish publication from there.

errors.means: Desk was still admitting or verifying this session's desk, so the call was refused before anything ran.

doors.when: Telling Desk which card this session's time belongs to, or clearing that for a side conversation

errors.fix: Check the track and slug with desk_search, then call again.

errors.means: Only one of track and slug was given.
errors.fix: Pass both track and slug, or clear: true.

errors.means: clear: true was combined with display_label.
errors.fix: Send clear: true alone.

errors.means: Desk was still admitting or verifying this session's desk, so the call was refused before anything ran.
errors.fix: Call desk_status, then repeat the call once it reports ready.

doors.when: After the operator answers a delivery, logging their acceptance or refusal against the delivered card

errors.means: The task is not at done, so there is nothing delivered to sign off; nothing was recorded.
errors.fix: Finish the task and move it to done with task_update first.

errors.means: A refusal came without the operator's reason.
errors.fix: Pass reason as one of the listed values.

errors.means: No task with that track and slug exists in this desk.
errors.fix: Check the track and slug, then call again.

errors.means: Desk was still admitting or verifying this session's desk, so the call was refused before anything ran.

doors.when: Opening a new drawer for a stream of related work, with a one-line scope saying what belongs there

errors.means: The slug is not 1 to 6 lowercase kebab-case words of at most 48 characters, or it is a catch-all or a person's name.
errors.fix: Pick a short outcome name and call again.

errors.means: The scope is missing, spans more than one line, or is longer than 240 characters.
errors.fix: Rewrite scope as one line of at most 240 characters, such as what belongs; not what doesn't.

errors.means: A track with that slug already exists.
errors.fix: Use track_update on it, or choose another slug.

errors.means: Desk was still admitting or verifying this session's desk, so the call was refused before anything ran.

doors.when: Changing an existing drawer's scope or other header fields, appending to its body, or renaming it

errors.means: No track exists at that slug.
errors.fix: Check the slug, then call again.

errors.means: The new scope is empty, spans more than one line, or is longer than 240 characters, the check track_create applies.
errors.fix: Rewrite scope as one line of at most 240 characters.

errors.means: A rename was sent together with other changes.
errors.fix: Send the rename alone, then send the update.

errors.means: Desk was still admitting or verifying this session's desk, so the call was refused before anything ran.

doors.when: Logging a snag in setup or in Desk itself; system snags about a tool Ouro owns file an issue on its repository, and Desk's own keep an improvement card

errors.means: System friction came without a one-line title.
errors.fix: Pass title on one line and call again.

errors.means: about was neither setup nor system.
errors.fix: Pass about as setup or system.

errors.means: The GitHub issue for system friction could not be filed; the note itself was saved.
errors.fix: Act on the reason in the message, such as signing in, then call again; the retry adds a second friction entry.

errors.means: Desk was still admitting or verifying this session's desk, so the call was refused before anything ran.

errors.means: scope was missing or not personal, desk or team.
errors.fix: Pass scope as personal, desk or team.

errors.means: topic, body, repo or source spans more than one line; a lesson is one rule.
errors.fix: Rewrite the lesson as one line and call again.

errors.means: A team lesson came without repo, outside a Crew shared workspace.
errors.fix: Pass repo, the path of your local clone of the team's repository.

errors.means: Another session is writing the same file; nothing was written.

doors.when: Committing a plan, spec or report file written by hand inside the desk, or sending its text from a client without a filesystem

errors.means: message was missing or not a string.
errors.fix: Pass a commit message string.

errors.means: A path in files is outside this session's write prefix.
errors.fix: Pass paths inside the write prefix, such as desks/<alias>/ in a shared workspace.

errors.means: paths included a task card, which only the task tools commit.
errors.fix: Remove the card from paths and change it with task_update, task_create or task_archive.

errors.means: A file's content in files is over 1 MiB.

errors.means: filters was not an object or a JSON string holding one, so nothing was searched.
errors.fix: Pass filters as a JSON object, for example track and status.

errors.means: Desk was still admitting or verifying this session's desk, so the call was refused before anything ran.
errors.fix: Call desk_status, then repeat the call once it reports ready.

errors.means: No source names a desk for this session, so there is no desk to act on.

doors.when: Asking the desk about a topic by meaning, to find earlier decisions and evidence whose wording you can't guess

errors.means: Desk was still admitting or verifying this session's desk, so the call was refused before anything ran.

errors.fix: Call desk_status and follow its fix, such as restoring the folder.

doors.when: From a client that can't load plugin skills, listing Desk's skills or reading one skill's full text

errors.means: No skill by that name is installed.
errors.fix: Call desk_skill with no name for the list.

errors.means: The name is not lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
errors.fix: Pass a skill name from desk_skill's list.

errors.means: The skill needs a shell, which hosted Desk does not have.
errors.fix: Do that step on a machine running Desk locally, or skip that skill.

doors.when: First call of a session, or whenever Desk seems off, to learn readiness, the bound location, sync and active work

errors.means: No source names a desk, so the answer's state is setup_required with code no_desk_root and the paths tried.
errors.fix: Follow the answer's fix to bind a desk, then call desk_status again.

errors.means: A binding names a desk root that cannot be read, so the state is degraded:root_unavailable; Desk does not fall back.
errors.fix: Follow the answer's fix, such as restoring the folder, then call desk_status again.

doors.when: When the runtime misbehaves: diagnosing startup, switching the checkout back to its state branch, reindexing search or recording factory consent

errors.means: switch_state_branch was asked for, but this session has no desk root or no state branch configured.
errors.fix: Skip the repair; a host passes --state-branch when a checkout must stay on one branch.

errors.means: reindex was asked for, but the session's search engine could not start, so the call was refused as degraded.
errors.fix: Call desk_status to retry starting it, then call desk_doctor with reindex: true again.

errors.means: factory_consent was given, but this store's decision is already recorded.
errors.fix: Leave it; the operator has already answered.

errors.means: factory_consent was given, but this session resolves no factory store.
errors.fix: Leave it; there is no question to answer.
